question: Which of the following government portal/initiative is specifically aimed at breaking language barriers by enabling Indian languages for digital services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BHASHINI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **BHASHINI**, which stands for **Bharat Interface for Smart Indian Languages**, is the **National Language Translation Mission** launched by the **Government of India**.
 
• It was officially launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in **July 2022** during the **Digital India Week** held in **Gandhinagar, Gujarat**.
 
• The primary objective of the initiative is to **break language barriers** by utilizing **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Machine Learning (ML)** technologies to provide digital content and services in **Indian languages**. ***Hence, the correct answer is BHASHINI.***
 
• The platform aims to enable citizens to access the internet and digital government services in their **native languages**, thereby promoting **digital inclusion** for those who are not proficient in English.
